Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.widgets.swing

Class SwingWidgetLayer

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.widgets.swing.SwingWidgetLayer
public final class SwingWidgetLayer extends Object
The conventional-Swing desktop's widget layer: the 2D counterpart of the 3D WidgetHost/WidgetLayer. It drops the same pure-Swing WidgetCards onto the desktop's JDesktopPane - behind the application internal frames, above the wallpaper - makes them draggable, and persists the layout through the very same WidgetConfigStore (~/.config/lg3d/widgets.properties) the 3D desktop uses, so a layout saved under one desktop is honoured by the other.

Nothing here references Java 3D, so the layer installs and runs on a JVM where the Java 3D jars are missing entirely. Desktop2D installs it reflectively via install(JDesktopPane); the widget gallery reaches the live layer through current() to add and remove widgets.

One shared ScheduledExecutorService drives every card's periodic WidgetCard.tick(); a tick updates volatile model fields and calls repaint(), so adding widgets adds no threads and no EDT work.

    • loadPersisted

      public void loadPersisted()
      Loads the persisted layout, or seeds the defaults (clock + temperature) on a genuinely fresh desktop.

      The defaults are seeded only the first time the layout is initialized. Once initialized, an empty instance list means the user removed every widget, and that choice is honoured across a restart instead of resurrecting the starter widgets.
